name: Exp_SilverTrend_Signal_ReOpen
summary: This EA trades based on the SilverTrend Signal indicator, which identifies trend direction changes using a channel-based algorithm similar to ASI (Accumulation Swing Index). It features a ReOpen mechanism that adds additional positions in the same direction when the signal persists, allowing pyramiding into established trends.
summary_zh: 该EA基于SilverTrend信号指标进行交易，该指标通过类似ASI的通道算法识别趋势方向变化。它具有ReOpen机制，当信号持续时可在同方向上增加额外仓位，实现趋势确立后的金字塔加仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于SilverTrend Signal指标，该指标通过计算价格通道和波动幅度来识别趋势转折点，当价格突破通道上轨时产生买入信号，突破下轨时产生卖出信号。入场条件为SilverTrend指标发出方向信号，首次信号开仓，后续同方向信号触发ReOpen加仓。出场条件主要依赖反向信号平仓，即当指标发出相反方向信号时关闭所有同向头寸。仓位管理采用ReOpen机制，允许在趋势延续时多次加仓，加仓次数由参数控制。资金管理方面，支持固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算，但缺少明确的止损机制。整体策略属于趋势跟踪型，通过加仓来放大趋势利润，但风险控制相对薄弱。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the SilverTrend Signal indicator, which identifies trend reversal points by calculating price channels and volatility ranges, generating buy signals when price breaks above the upper channel and sell signals when breaking below the lower channel. Entry conditions are triggered by SilverTrend indicator directional signals, with the first signal opening an initial position and subsequent same-direction signals triggering ReOpen additional positions. Exit conditions primarily rely on opposing signals to close all positions in the same direction when the indicator issues a reverse signal. Position sizing employs the ReOpen mechanism, allowing multiple entries in the trend direction with the number of re-entries controlled by input parameters. Money management supports fixed lots or balance-based dynamic lot calculation, but lacks explicit stop-loss mechanisms. The overall strategy is trend-following, amplifying trend profits through pyramiding, but risk control is relatively weak.

parameters.name: MoneyManagement
parameters.description: 是否启用资金管理动态手数
parameters.description_en: Enable money management dynamic lot size

parameters.name: RiskPercent
parameters.description: 风险百分比，用于动态计算手数
parameters.description_en: Per-trade risk percentage based on account balance

parameters.name: ReOpen
parameters.description: 是否允许同方向重新开仓加仓
parameters.description_en: Allow re-entry in same direction to add position

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈

pros: 趋势跟踪加仓机制可以在强趋势行情中显著放大利润
SilverTrend信号基于通道算法，能有效过滤部分噪音假信号
支持资金管理动态手数计算，提供了灵活的仓位控制选项
参数设计简洁直观，用户易于理解和调优
pros_en: The ReOpen pyramiding mechanism can significantly amplify profits during strong trending markets
SilverTrend signal is based on channel algorithm, effectively filtering some noise and false signals
Supports money management with dynamic lot calculation, providing flexible position sizing options
Clean and intuitive parameter design makes it easy for users to understand and optimize
cons: 缺少止损机制是重大风险缺陷，单笔交易亏损可能无限扩大
加仓机制在震荡行情中会导致多次逆势建仓，造成严重亏损
仅依赖反向信号平仓，在快速反转行情中可能无法及时退出
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
缺少点差过滤，在不利点差条件下仍会执行交易
cons_en: Lack of stop-loss mechanism is a critical risk flaw, as single trade losses can expand indefinitely
The ReOpen mechanism can lead to multiple adverse positions during ranging markets, causing severe drawdowns
Relying solely on opposing signals for exit may fail to exit timely during rapid market reversals
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same candle
No spread filter, executing trades even under unfavorable spread conditions
improvements: 增加强制止损和追踪止损功能，控制单笔和整体风险
添加震荡/趋势市场识别过滤器，在震荡市中禁用加仓机制
增加新K线检查和点差过滤，避免重复开仓和高成本交易
improvements_en: Add mandatory stop-loss and trailing stop functionality to control per-trade and overall risk
Implement ranging/trending market identification filter to disable ReOpen during choppy markets
Add new bar check and spread filter to prevent duplicate entries and high-cost trades

risk_points: 无止损机制，单笔亏损不可控
ReOpen加仓在逆势时可能累积大量亏损头寸
无新K线检查可能导致同根K线重复开仓
缺少点差过滤在高点差环境下可能造成滑点损失
risk_points_en: No stop-loss mechanism means uncontrolled per-trade losses
ReOpen pyramiding can accumulate large losing positions against the trend
No new bar check may cause duplicate entries on the same candle
Lack of spread filter can lead to slippage losses under high spread conditions

It features a ReOpen mechanism that adds additional positions in the same direction when the signal persists, allowing pyramiding into established trends.
